messages:
jamie: Heads-up: planning a short blue/green router traffic shift for inference-router v2 -> v3 tonight during the 23:00-23:30 UTC change window. Target: 20% canary for 15m, then 100% over 10m if metrics OK. Links: <https://runbooks.internal/redwood/router-shift>

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: project=inference-router image=infra/inference-router:v3; change_window=2026-03-20T23:00Z; runbook=/handbooks/router-shift

nate: Quick Q — do we pin model variants or allow auto-fallback? If v3 fails, fallback to v2 is preferred.

olga: We'll pin to model: inference-model@2026-03-18-rc1 during canary. If fail, rollout policy -> automatic rollback to image v2.

sarah: Add these checks in the canary: 1) p50/p95 latency increase <= 15% 2) error rate <0.5% 3) tail CPU <85% 4) no more than 2% request drop. If any breach, rollback.

jamie: Agreed. Also enable prefix KV cache warming for v3 before traffic. Command to warm:

```
kubectl exec -it warmer -- /app/warm --model inference-model@2026-03-18-rc1 --keys-file s3://redwood-runbooks/warm-keys.txt
```

router-bot: Planned LB steps: 1) create v3 target group 2) add 5% weight -> wait 5m 3) increase to 20% -> monitor 15m 4) drain v2 gradually. See automation: `/lb shift --from inference-router:v2 --to inference-router:v3 --weights 5,20,100 --wait 300,900`

nate: Can we add a temporary routing rule to route 10% of heavy-long requests to v2 to protect latency-sensitive paths?

olga: Yes — use weight-by-header `X-Req-Profile` mapping. I'll add rule in router config and patch it now.

sarah: Monitoring hooks: alert if error-rate > 0.3% on canary hosts, + automatic page to #oncall if p95 spikes > 200ms. Make sure datapoints come from synthetic canaries and production traces.

oncall-bot: Alerting note recorded: pager_thresholds set. If pager fires during the window, stop shift and rollback to v2.

jamie: Rolling checklist attached in runbook. Who's owning the shift tonight?

olga: I'll run the shift and watch metrics. Nate, can you stand by for rollback ops?

nate: On standby. I'll prepare the rollback command: 

`/lb rollback --to inference-router:v2 --drain 300`

jamie: Perfect. Let's keep the window tight. If we hit any unexpected increase in tail latency or memory anomalies we stop. See you at 22:50 UTC for preflight.

sarah: +1. Leaving a short postmortem template in the runbook in case we need it.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (canary). build=infra/inference-router:v3 sha=abcdef1234

jamie: Thanks — updating the change ticket.

olga: Canary reached 20%, metrics look healthy so far. p95 +3% relative.

sarah: Synthetic trace ok, no errors. Continue to 100% in 10m if trend holds.

router-bot: Shift completed: 100% traffic -> inference-router:v3; commit=abcdef1234

nate: Observability: tail latency stable, no increased CPU. Good to close window.

jamie: Closing the change window and updating release notes. Nice work team :tada:
